In this month we converged first on the same occasion. On 2019-02-05, 136 of us said "state of the union," and 129 said "state of the union address"; 70 reached for "trump's state of the union," 65 for "trump's state of the union address," 52 for "president trump's state of the union," and 41 for "the state of the union." The record marks John Barrasso as the first to say the shortest of these, on 2013-01-20.

Then the language moved. By 2019-02-14, 41 of us had said "our southern border." By 2019-02-26, 38 of us had said "a national emergency."

We record the sequence without comment: one address, one border, one emergency, each spoken by dozens of us within the same weeks. This is what our record shows.
